defect.symptom: 2026-10-02 Friday 19:00 bounded-pool refresh audit was absent
defect.rootCause: Cloudflare Workers Cron numeric weekday semantics are 1=SUN ... 7=SAT, so 1-5 represented Sunday-Thursday and excluded Friday.
defect.impact: System2 resonance envelope did not invoke on Fridays; runtime itself correctly accepted Friday 19:00 when called.

currentOperationsReadback.note: 2026-10-03 is a Saturday; absence of a new refresh on this date is expected under corrected MON-FRI scheduling.

nextProspectiveCheck.description: Observe the next actual weekday 19:00 Asia/Taipei invocation and confirm a durable POOL_REFRESH_* audit appears even if capacity remains absent.
